components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary dispatch, approval, and publish CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #2563EB); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2563EB); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Signal Badge
components.description: Server-verified telemetry and trip workflow pill with leading semantic beacon.
components.css: .ds-badge-emerald { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #F0FDFA; color: #0F766E; border: 1px solid #99F6E4; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0D9488; }

narrative.overview: SolTransit operates like a daylight maritime harbor pilot's bridge rather than a consumer ride-hailing app. Every surface—from a transport manager's multi-shift dispatch desk to an employee's pickup pass and a driver's stationary cab console—speaks one disciplined visual grammar: daylight mineral-white paper, Prussian navy typographic authority, restrained Harbor Cobalt primary actions, and strict semantic signal beacons.
keyCharacteristics: Staleness-Honest Telemetry Beacons paired with exact tabular timestamps and delay seconds
Non-Destructive Stamped States preserving auditable transition history
Hairline-ruled daylight operational manifests with focus-trapped slide-over inspectors

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Inactive cards and neutral icons stay monochrome #0F2544 / #5B6E84 so emerald, amber, cobalt, and crimson signal badges read cleanly on first scan.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Page h1 titles (AdminShell) and section h2 headings (ManifestHeader, roadmap banners) appear cleanly without uppercase eyebrow kickers stacked above them.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All KPI counts, trip codes, timestamps (Asia/Kolkata), GPS coordinates, rupee currency (en-IN INR), vehicle capacities, and delay durations enforce font-mono tabular-nums.

rules.name: Single-Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Rest-state cards separate solely via 1px borders with zero drop shadows; floating drawers and overlays declare depth solely via directional shadows.

dos: Do associate every form Input / Select / checkbox with unique IDs (useId() for shared shell controls) and explicit FieldLabel or aria-label.
Do give table rows explicit keyboard-accessible button or Link triggers rather than relying solely on click handlers.
Do use Lucide SVG icons (aria-hidden when decorative) and real domain fixtures (Hyderabad corridors, IST timestamps, INR paise formatting).
donts: Don't nest interactive elements (use buttonVariants on Link instead of wrapping Button inside Link).
Don't animate CSS layout properties (width, height, top) when transform: scaleX() suffices.
Don't place standalone uppercase badge kickers directly above h1/h2 headings or show raw enum underscores in visible prose headings.
